# FocusNodeSpec

Defined in: [src/sdk/gameplay.ts:70](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/sdk/gameplay.ts#L70)

Gameplay for one focus; graph topology supplies IDs, prerequisites and layout.

## Remarks

Cost uses the game's focus points (normally seven days per point),
not a fixed duration. The configured NFocus.FOCUS_POINT_DAYS define controls it.
